region.description: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

bucket.description: S3 bucket configuration where inventory results are published (documented below). The `bucket` configuration supports the following:

name.description: Unique identifier of the inventory configuration for the bucket.

included_object_versions.description: Object versions to include in the inventory list. Valid values: `All`, `Current`.

schedule.description: Specifies the schedule for generating inventory results (documented below).

destination.description: Contains information about where to publish the inventory results (documented below).

enabled.description: Specifies whether the inventory is enabled or disabled.

filter.description: Specifies an inventory filter. The inventory only includes objects that meet the filter's criteria (documented below).

optional_fields.description: List of optional fields that are included in the inventory results. Please refer to the S3 [documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_InventoryConfiguration.html#AmazonS3-Type-InventoryConfiguration-OptionalFields) for more details. The `filter` configuration supports the following:

prefix.description: Prefix that is prepended to all inventory results.

frequency.description: Specifies how frequently inventory results are produced. Valid values: `Daily`, `Weekly`. The `destination` configuration supports the following:

bucket_arn.description: Amazon S3 bucket ARN of the destination.

format.description: Specifies the output format of the inventory results. Can be `CSV`, [`ORC`](https://orc.apache.org/) or [`Parquet`](https://parquet.apache.org/).

account_id.description: ID of the account that owns the destination bucket. Recommended to be set to prevent problems if the destination bucket ownership changes.

encryption.description: Contains the type of server-side encryption to use to encrypt the inventory (documented below). The `encryption` configuration supports the following:

sse_kms.description: Specifies to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS-managed keys to encrypt the inventory file (documented below).

sse_s3.description: Specifies to use server-side encryption with Amazon S3-managed keys (SSE-S3) to encrypt the inventory file. The `sse_kms` configuration supports the following:

key_id.description: ARN of the KMS customer master key (CMK) used to encrypt the inventory file.
